ValidationRule.description: Only users with the Modon Egypt - Salesforce Integration profile can set Status to Reversed for Modon - Egypt records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Source_Entity__c = "Modon - Egypt", ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Reversed"), $Profile.Name <> "Modon Egypt - Salesforce Integration Profile" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You don't have permission to set Status to Reversed for this record.
